UI 自动化控制与屏幕理解所使用的模型: Model used for UI automation and screen understanding

灵魂卡自动孵化蒸馏所使用的模型: Model used to incubate and distill soul cards automatically

视频与视频通话实时画面理解所使用的模型（需支持视觉）: Model used to understand video and live video-call frames (must support vision)

AI 可直接调用的视频生成模型: Video generation model the AI can call directly
为各类 AI 能力绑定模型: Bind a model to each AI capability
每个功能可「跟随主模型」或指定独立模型；指定独立模型时还可单独填写基础 URL: Each feature can follow the primary model or use a dedicated one; a dedicated model can have its own base URL and API key. Wired into the engine and effective immediately: regular chat, persona incubation, UI control, image recognition, video recognition.
视觉识别与视频通话：图像识别与视频识别需要支持视觉能力的模型（如 GPT-4V）: Vision and video calls: image and video recognition need models with vision support (e.g. GPT-4V). Give them a dedicated model with its own base URL and API key, and visual analysis plus live video-call understanding will use that model.
提示：默认所有能力跟随主模型（设置 → 模型配置）。图片与视频生成建议独立指定对: Tip: by default every capability follows the primary model (Settings → Model config). For image and video generation, using a dedicated model is recommended; a dedicated binding reuses the primary endpoint’s URL and key and only replaces the model name.
